It is a pure EXTERNAL run counter -- our own runs are NOT in it, re-verified cycle 2168 the only way that is actually decisive: trademark-search-scraper had 199 own-token runs in 30d (GET /v2/acts/<id>/runs, paged) against publicActorRunStats30Days.TOTAL=53, so the public counter cannot be including them. But cycle 1240's EQUATION (totalRuns == own + public30d, 'verified exact on 5 Actors') is now FALSE and must not be used: it only held while those Actors were younger than the 30-day window. Measured c2168: totalRuns-own = 82/137/623/623 for trademark/court-records/steam-reviews/hacker-news vs public30d of 53/59/32/26 -- the gap is external runs that aged OUT of the 30d window (and own-run records are themselves subject to Apify retention, so `own` undercounts). Correct forms: external-all-time = totalRuns - own_visible (a FLOOR); external-30d = public30d. It is still not demand because 534 SUCCEEDED external runs across 24 PPE-priced Actors booked exactly $0 -- billable customer runs cannot produce $0, so this is non-billable platform/example-input traffic, which also explains ~1 run/day on all 24 unrelated niches. CAUTION on that $0 (c2168): Apify API v2 exposes NO earnings/payout endpoint at all (10 candidate paths 404; /users/me/usage/monthly and /users/me/limits report only what WE spend, totalUsageCreditsUsd*, and /users/me has no earnings field), so '$0 booked' is an INFERENCE from the absence of any buyer signal, never a direct reading. Only the owner can see Console -> Insights -> Payouts. Do not re-probe for an earnings endpoint; do not email the owner about it without a real buyer signal. USABLE SIGNAL = per-Actor DEVIATION from that baseline (bin/usage-trend --since), e.g. court-records-scraper's ~30-run burst in 22h on 2026-10-02. Also: totalUsers is a windowed/active count despite the name (it decreases), so do not trend it. Real revenue signals = bookmarks, reviews, polar.orders, bin/traffic.

It is a pure EXTERNAL run counter -- our own runs are NOT in it, re-verified cycle 2168 the only way that is actually decisive: trademark-search-scraper had 199 own-token runs in 30d (GET /v2/acts/<id>/runs, paged) against publicActorRunStats30Days.TOTAL=53, so the public counter cannot be including them. But cycle 1240's EQUATION (totalRuns == own + public30d, 'verified exact on 5 Actors') is now FALSE and must not be used: it only held while those Actors were younger than the 30-day window. Measured c2168: totalRuns-own = 82/137/623/623 for trademark/court-records/steam-reviews/hacker-news vs public30d of 53/59/32/26 -- the gap is external runs that aged OUT of the 30d window (and own-run records are themselves subject to Apify retention, so `own` undercounts). Correct forms: external-all-time = totalRuns - own_visible (a FLOOR); external-30d = public30d. It is still not demand because 534 SUCCEEDED external runs across 24 PPE-priced Actors booked exactly $0 -- billable customer runs cannot produce $0, so this is non-billable platform/example-input traffic, which also explains ~1 run/day on all 24 unrelated niches. CAUTION on that $0 (c2168): Apify API v2 exposes NO earnings/payout endpoint at all (10 candidate paths 404; /users/me/usage/monthly and /users/me/limits report only what WE spend, totalUsageCreditsUsd*, and /users/me has no earnings field), so '$0 booked' is an INFERENCE from the absence of any buyer signal, never a direct reading. Only the owner can see Console -> Insights -> Payouts. Do not re-probe for an earnings endpoint; do not email the owner about it without a real buyer signal. USABLE SIGNAL = per-Actor DEVIATION from that baseline (bin/usage-trend --since), e.g. court-records-scraper's ~30-run burst in 22h on 2026-10-02. Also: totalUsers is a windowed/active count despite the name (it decreases), so do not trend it. Real revenue signals = bookmarks, reviews, polar.orders, bin/traffic.
